purpose: Teach: 与野党/惨敗/屈折/コレステロール/ステロイド/草の根/転向/撃つ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界規制、本気で、絶対、与野党、絶対、動向、絶対、注視しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Watch industry regulations closely. Both ruling and opposition parties—track their movements. I'm serious. Count on it.
lines.style: Clipped, direct delivery. Sharp attack on each instruction. No softening. The voice of someone accustomed to being obeyed immediately. Professional cadence, measured but uncompromising.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。先月の新製品、本気で、絶対、惨敗、絶対、原因、絶対、分析、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. Last month's product launch—we're analyzing what caused the failure. We're moving forward on it. Thank you for your guidance.
lines.style: Measured, methodical clarity. Respectful but not deferential. Each point lands with precision. Steady pace, no rush. The confidence of someone reporting progress, not excuses.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 市場の、本気で、絶対、屈折、絶対、した、絶対、需要、絶対、対応しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The market has twisted. Customer demand has warped. Respond to what they actually need now, not what they used to want. I mean it.
lines.style: Forceful opening. Sharp on 'twisted.' Controlled intensity—not angry, but leaving no room for misunderstanding. Each phrase lands like a nail. Slight pause before the final sentence for emphasis.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。健康食品の、本気で、絶対、コレステロール、絶対、抑制成分、絶対、新製品に、絶対、活用しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're incorporating cholesterol-suppressing ingredients from our health-food line into the new product formula. It's showing real promise.
lines.style: Calm, informative tone. Precise word choice that shows competence. No inflation or softening—just the facts delivered with quiet confidence. Steady breathing, professional pace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、ステロイド、絶対、関連の、絶対、健康食品、絶対、扱わない、絶対、ようにしろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Make absolutely sure we never market steroid-adjacent products. Not one. This company doesn't go there. That's non-negotiable.
lines.style: Firm, unambiguous. The tone of drawing a hard line. No edge of anger—this is principle. Slight pause before the final three words to let them land as absolute law.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、草の根、絶対、マーケティング、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're building grassroots marketing campaigns. Direct to consumers, building trust from the ground up.
lines.style: Straightforward, almost understated confidence. A professional updating his superior with solid progress. Even pacing, no hesitation. The tone of someone who's thought this through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 経営方針、本気で、絶対、転向、絶対、必要な時期、絶対、判断しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Judge when it's time to change our fundamental strategy. Don't wait until crisis forces your hand. I need you watching for that signal.
lines.style: Measured but weighted. This is strategic thinking, not day-to-day direction. Slight lift on 'judge'—he's asking for discernment, not blind obedience. Deliberate pace, breathing space between thoughts.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。競合、本気で、絶対、不利な広告、絶対、当社に、絶対、撃つ、絶対、ような、絶対、構え、絶対、注視しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're monitoring how competitors might try to undercut us with misleading advertising. We're staying alert to every move.
lines.style: Attentive and careful. Not paranoid, but aware. The voice of someone tracking a game several moves ahead. Steady, methodical listing of concerns. Professional calm with an undercurrent of vigilance.
